import pandas as pd

# Load source data
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_97/training_0.csv"
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Perform the transformation as per operation history:
# group_by = [Source1_97_0.crit_cn]
# aggregations = [count(Source1_97_0.critic)]

# Group by 'crit_cn' and count the number of 'critic' entries per group
df_transformed = df_source0.groupby('crit_cn', as_index=False).agg(critic=('critic', 'count'))

# Ensure the schema matches target schema: ['crit_cn': string, 'critic': integer]
df_transformed['crit_cn'] = df_transformed['crit_cn'].astype(str)
df_transformed['critic'] = df_transformed['critic'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_97/target_multisource.csv"
df_transformed.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source table
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_97/training_0.csv", index_col=0)

# Union step (only one source, so no actual union needed)
df_union = source0.copy()

# Group by crit_cn and count critic
result = df_union.groupby("crit_cn", as_index=False).agg({"critic": "count"})

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_97/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
